head: codex/316-v0921-v0922-planning
title: [v0.92][WP-28] Reconcile v0.92.1 and plan CodeFriend Beta 1
body:
Closes #316

Publishes the complete canonical v0.92.1 planning reconciliation and a number-free v0.92.2 CodeFriend Beta 1 milestone package. The package includes the standard milestone documents, feature and proof surfaces, execution specifications, dependency graph, full canonical release tail, explicit deferrals, and the global feature-list handoff.

The v0.92.1 opening route is deliberately operator-controlled: merge makes the package eligible, but creates nothing. Only when the operator later declares the milestone ready will the operator create the number-free WP-01 conductor; WP-01 then creates the 31 planned child issues. Closed #431 is provenance only, and the validator rejects any concrete closed conductor, missing future owner, or WP-01 self-creation.

A 40-row source-disposition ledger accounts for every selected planning input. Focused validators prove 39 v0.92.1 planned IDs with 31 creation slots, 21 v0.92.2 planned IDs with nine feature documents, both ten-step release tails, links, portability, and exact source-denominator truth.

No implementation issues are created by this PR, no future product completion is claimed, and merge is left to the operator. Independent exact-head remediation review passed with no findings.
